workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars for the 30-minute partners' meeting next week. Here are the times they are both free:

Mon: 09:00-10:00
Tue: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
Fri: 11:00-12:00

Could you please check these times against Elena's and David's calendars and let me know which 30-minute slot works for them? Thanks, Alison

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars against the times you provided. The only slot that works for all four partners is Thursday from 14:30-15:00. Could you please go ahead and book that? Thanks, Brad

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks, Brad. I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. It's over to you to send the confirmation email.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, just checking in to see if you've sent the confirmation email for the partners' meeting on Thursday at 14:30. Let me know when it's done so we can mark this task as complete. Thanks, Alison

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, all done. The confirmation email was sent just after your last message. The task is complete. Thanks for your help! - Brad

emails.body:
Dear Partners,

This email confirms the booking of the 30-minute partners' meeting for next week.

Date: Thursday, November 19, 2026
Time: 14:30-15:00 Eastern

An invitation with a calendar event will follow shortly.

Best regards,
Brad
